body.text: Navigating a private jet fbo turkey arrival involves choosing the right runway for your ground destination, coordinating Turkish civil aviation permits, and aligning FBO handling with your executive ground fleet. Whether you are arriving for board meetings in Istanbul, medical consultations, or a summer yacht embarkation in Bodrum or Antalya, ground logistics determine how much time you actually save. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/), our two founders coordinate FBO ground transfers, helicopter charters, and executive itineraries on a flat-fee, client-paid basis ("Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions."), keeping handling markups and chauffeur pricing transparent.
Why do private jets in Istanbul primarily use Atatürk General Aviation Terminal (ISL) instead of IST?

Per the [General Directorate of State Airports Authority (DHMİ)](https://www.dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Slot/ISL.pdf), Istanbul Atatürk Airport (ISL / LTBA) is reserved exclusively for general aviation, business flights, air taxi, cargo, maintenance, and state traffic—meaning zero commercial airline congestion and shorter taxi times. Located in Yeşilköy on the Marmara coast, ISL cuts 25 to 40 minutes off the drive to the Bosphorus, Sultanahmet, and Levent compared to Istanbul Airport (IST / LTFM) in Arnavutköy.

That balance shifted slightly in May 2026 when [iGA Istanbul Airport and Jetex inaugurated the Jetex iGA General Aviation Terminal](https://www.istairport.com/en/announcements/jetex-and-iga-istanbul-airport-unveil-the-worlds-largest-vip-terminal?locale=en) at IST ([DHMİ](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Haber/the-new-route-for-private-jets-is-istanbul-airport.aspx)). IST is now a strong choice if you are connecting directly from a private jet onto a long-haul commercial flight or heading to northern Istanbul, whereas ISL remains the preferred business-aviation base for rapid access to central hotels and corporate offices.
How fast is customs and immigration clearance at ISL, BJV and AYT FBOs?

When advance passenger manifests (GenDec) and passport data are filed with your licensed ground handler before takeoff, dedicated police and customs officers inside the General Aviation Terminals at ISL, [Milas-Bodrum (BJV)](https://milas-bodrumairport.com/en/general-aviation-terminal), and [Fraport TAV Antalya (AYT)](https://www.antalya-airport.aero/sustainability-1/expansion-project) clear arriving passengers in 5 to 15 minutes from aircraft door open to curbside departure.

body.text: At BJV and AYT, July and August Friday afternoons can occasionally add five to ten minutes if multiple heavy jets land within the same 20-minute arrival bank, making early slot coordination essential.
How do apron-side Mercedes S-Class or helicopter transfers work?

For standard GA arrivals, airside-cleared VIP tarmac vans meet your aircraft steps and drive you 60 to 120 seconds to the private GAT lounge for passport stamping, where your chauffeured Mercedes S-Class, Maybach, or V-Class waits directly outside the private exit door. Direct aircraft-to-vehicle apron transfers require special diplomatic or prior security clearance via your FBO handler.

Helicopter transfers—popular from ISL to Bosphorus helipads or from BJV to Yalıkavak and Göcek yacht marinas—operate from designated helipad stands inside the airport perimeter. Once customs clears your luggage in the GAT, a five-minute airside transfer delivers you straight to the waiting twin-engine helicopter (such as an AW139 or Bell 429), cutting a 50-minute summer Bodrum peninsula drive to 12 minutes in the air.
What permits and handling lead times apply in summer peak?

All foreign-registered flights entering Turkish airspace operate under the [Directorate General of Civil Aviation (SHGM)](https://web.shgm.gov.tr/en/ucus-izinleri/3893-index). Non-scheduled charter flights require official landing permits, while private non-commercial flights under certain bilateral regimes still require airport slots, Prior Permission Required (PPR), and confirmed parking—especially at BJV and AYT between June and September.
Use this pre-flight coordination checklist for summer peak operations:

items: 7–10 days prior: Request airport slots and overnight parking at BJV (Milas-Bodrum) or AYT (Antalya), where ramp parking fills quickly on summer weekends.
3–5 business days prior: Submit charter landing permit applications and full crew/aircraft documentation through your Turkish ground handler to SHGM (working hours run Monday–Friday, 06:00Z–14:00Z).
48 hours prior: Lock in final passenger manifests, dietary catering requests, and armored or executive ground vehicle plate numbers with the FBO.
24 hours prior: Reconfirm weather minimums and heliport landing permissions if connecting by rotorcraft to Bodrum, Çeşme, or Göcek.

faq.q: Can commercial airlines still land at Istanbul Atatürk Airport (ISL)?
faq.a: No. Scheduled commercial passenger airlines relocated to Istanbul Airport (IST) in 2019. Under DHMİ slot regulations, ISL operates strictly for general aviation, business jets, air taxi, cargo, maintenance, and state flights.

faq.q: Is overnight private jet parking guaranteed at Bodrum (BJV) in July and August?
faq.a: No. Milas-Bodrum faces high general aviation parking demand during July and August weekends. Operators frequently drop passengers at BJV and reposition aircraft to nearby Izmir (ADB) or Dalaman (DLM) if overnight ramp slots are full.

faq.q: How far is the Jetex iGA Terminal at IST from the main commercial terminal?
faq.a: The Jetex iGA General Aviation Terminal sits in its own dedicated private complex within the Istanbul Airport perimeter, roughly a 10-minute airside or landside transfer from the main international terminal for commercial-to-private connections.

faq.q: Do private jet passengers still need a Turkish visa or e-Visa?
faq.a: Yes. Flying privately does not change Turkish immigration law. Passengers whose nationalities require an e-Visa or consular visa must obtain it before departure; FBO staff cannot issue visas on arrival for restricted passports.

faq.q: Can private jets fly directly into Bodrum or Antalya from outside Türkiye?
faq.a: Yes. Both Milas-Bodrum (BJV) and Antalya (AYT) are full international ports of entry with dedicated customs and immigration officers stationed inside their General Aviation Terminals.

faq.q: What is the fastest transfer from ISL to a Bosphorus hotel during rush hour?
faq.a: During weekday rush hour (17:00–20:00), road drives from ISL to Beşiktaş or Bebek can stretch past 60 minutes. A pre-cleared private helicopter transfer or a road transfer to Ataköy Marina followed by a private Bosphorus motor yacht cuts travel time sharply.
